responsibility: Managed Agent integration identities and the bounded, language-neutral operation request and report contract exchanged by the Worker job and the node-local writer; no Client submits one in this release. Actual consumers are orchbee-agent-integration-writer, which executes the contract on a node; orchbee-server and orchbee-worker, which carry and run the dormant integration job.
nonGoals: Executing inspections or mutations, changing provider configuration, owning threads, processes, cancellation, or deadlines, authorization, transport framing, rendering, or CLI grammar.
Defining Desktop's TypeScript integration writer, the Agent observation contract, or the provider registry itself.
